checks.name: Skip to Main Content Link
checks.details: App.tsx implements Skip to main content with visible focus ring on Tab.

checks.name: Modal Dialog Keyboard Dismissal (Escape)
checks.details: All modal dialogs (EvidenceDrawer, DecisionModal, ExportModal, SubmitReviewModal, ResolutionModal, BrandInsightsModal, AmbiguityReportModal, ConflictResolutionModal) implement keydown listeners for Escape.

checks.name: Dialog ARIA Modality & Labelling
checks.details: Modals implement role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and aria-labelledby pointing to their respective heading titles.

checks.name: Non-Colour Reliance for Status Badges
checks.details: SeverityBadge, CheckStatusChip, and State badges use explicit uppercase text labels (BLOCKER, WARNING, ADVISORY, APPROVED, STALE) accompanied by icons and ARIA labels, meeting WCAG 1.4.1.

checks.name: Explicit Form Labels & Required Indicators
checks.details: All form controls in intake, decision, rationale, and policy dialogs have paired <label htmlFor="..."> with required markers and character length counters.

checks.name: 200% Zoom & 320px Reflow (WCAG 1.4.10)
checks.details: Layout uses CSS Grid with minmax(340px, 1fr) and flex-wrap on header action toolbars; collapses cleanly to single column without horizontal page scrolling at 200% zoom or 320px width.

checks.name: Focus-Visible Rings on Interactive Elements
checks.details: CSS provides universal :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } for all buttons, inputs, links, and filter tabs.

checks.name: Accessible Alert Announcements
checks.details: <Alert> component implements role="alert" with aria-live="assertive" for immediate assistive technology feedback on API or validation failures.
